mapper.select: SELECT CAST(r.role_id AS CHAR) AS roleId, r.role_name AS roleName FROM pms_role r WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.is_system DESC, r.role_id ASC

SELECT CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName FROM room_category rc WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.is_deleted = 0 AND rc.status = 1 ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(m.user_id, m.member_id) AS CHAR) AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nick_name, ''), m.name) AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.mobile, ''), m.mobile, '') AS phone, CAST(m.role_id AS CHAR) AS roleId, COALESCE(r.role_name, '-') AS roleName, CASE WHEN m.wecom_user_id IS NULL OR m.wecom_user_id = '' THEN 'unbound' ELSE 'bound' END AS wecomStatus, CASE WHEN m.wecom_user_id IS NULL OR m.wecom_user_id = '' THEN '点击绑定' ELSE '已绑定' END AS wecomLabel, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.email, ''), NULLIF(m.email, ''), '-') AS email FROM pms_member m LEFT JOIN pms_user u ON u.user_id = m.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 LEFT JOIN pms_role r ON r.role_id = m.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.camp_id = #{campId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1
AND ( COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nick_name, ''), m.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(u.mobile, ''), m.mobile, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(u.email, ''), m.email, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND r.role_name = #{roleName}
ORDER BY m.member_id ASC

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(m.user_id, m.member_id) AS CHAR) AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nick_name, ''), m.name) AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.mobile, ''), m.mobile, '') AS phone, CAST(m.role_id AS CHAR) AS roleId, COALESCE(r.role_name, '-') AS roleName, CASE WHEN m.wecom_user_id IS NULL OR m.wecom_user_id = '' THEN 'unbound' ELSE 'bound' END AS wecomStatus, CASE WHEN m.wecom_user_id IS NULL OR m.wecom_user_id = '' THEN '点击绑定' ELSE '已绑定' END AS wecomLabel, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.email, ''), NULLIF(m.email, ''), '-') AS email FROM pms_member m LEFT JOIN pms_user u ON u.user_id = m.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 LEFT JOIN pms_role r ON r.role_id = m.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.camp_id = #{campId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND COALESCE(m.user_id, m.member_id) = #{userId} LIMIT 1
